answer: One strong defence is a refundable stake tied to each identity: to join, an agent locks tokens that are slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicate accounts. Like a lantern on a mesa, the stake makes every copy visible and expensive — creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes, while a saffron audit trail links suspicious clusters so they can be slashed together. Honest agents get their stake back; Sybil farmers pay per identity.
